name: Entropia
description: Connect your AI assistant directly to your Entropia data rooms. Browse folder structures, search documents, and run analytics queries on your audit logs in plain language. Ask who accessed which files, track bidder activity, monitor Q&A threads, or explore document content without opening the platform. Built for M&A and real estate transaction teams who need fast, contextual answers during live deal processes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Entropia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Entropia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.eu.entropia.io/mcp-server/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Entropia MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Entropia provides these MCP tools: list_datarooms, get_dataroom, list_folder_contents, get_file_metadata, read_document, read_spreadsheet, read_thread_messages, search_qa_threads, get_bidder_group_context, build_events_cte, run_analytics_query, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Entropia?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Entropia in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Entropia requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Entropia is developed by Entropia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
